about: Roles shown on the GEO board, by NORAD catalogue number. An object is listed only where published reporting supports the role; each entry cites it. Unlisted objects have no listed role, which says nothing about what they are. Curated by hand; checked 26 Oct 2026 (docs/validation/geo-board.md).

roles.inspection: Inspection-capable: publicly reported rendezvous, proximity operations or inspection of other satellites
roles.servicing: Servicing: docks with client satellites (life extension or refuelling)

objects.name: LUCH-5X (OLYMP-K 2)
objects.basis: Moved along the belt after its March 2023 launch, stopping near commercial satellites; closest measured about 16 km (Slingshot Aerospace)

objects.name: USA 270 (GSSAP 3)
objects.basis: US Space Force GSSAP satellite: operates near GEO and manoeuvres to inspect objects in the belt

objects.name: USA 271 (GSSAP 4)
objects.basis: US Space Force GSSAP satellite: operates near GEO and manoeuvres to inspect objects in the belt

objects.name: USA 324 (GSSAP 5)
objects.basis: US Space Force GSSAP satellite (launched Jan 2022): operates near GEO and manoeuvres to inspect objects in the belt

objects.name: USA 325 (GSSAP 6)
objects.basis: US Space Force GSSAP satellite (launched Jan 2022): operates near GEO and manoeuvres to inspect objects in the belt

objects.name: SHIJIAN-17 (SJ-17)
objects.basis: Chinese experimental satellite; circumnavigated ChinaSat-5A and later approached ChinaSat-6B and Shijian-20

objects.name: SHIJIAN-21 (SJ-21)
objects.basis: Docked with the defunct BeiDou-2 G2 and towed it about 3,000 km above GEO in January 2022; reported docked with Shijian-25 in 2025

objects.name: SHIJIAN-25 (SJ-25)
objects.basis: Built to test refuelling and life extension; tracking firms reported it docked with Shijian-21 in mid-2025 (not confirmed by China)

objects.name: MEV-1
objects.basis: Northrop Grumman Mission Extension Vehicle: docks with client satellites to extend their life

objects.name: MEV-2
objects.basis: Northrop Grumman Mission Extension Vehicle; docked to Intelsat 10-02 on 12 Apr 2021, undocking planned for 2026
